fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 builds the 0x228-byte object inline and stores vptr 0x7104f88b88 (base/other class 0x7104f702f0, 0x220 bytes; same slot functions except +0x110..+0x128), then stores it at boma+0x190.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Builder stores the boma here; init slot (+0x28) reads [boma+0x8]+0x8 (battle object id) through it; other slots reach boma modules via [this+0x8].

fields.name: lua_thread (lua_State of this object's agent)
fields.evidence: Builder zeroes it; init slot (+0x28, f_710048aa30) creates a state through f_7103726d80 and stores it here (releasing the previous one with f_7103726ec0); uninit slot (+0x30) and the destructor release and zero it; status-func setters push values on it (f_710391dde0 on [+0x10]).

fields.name: state_flag (1)
fields.evidence: Builder stores 1; no exported reader traced.

fields.name: script_work_area (0x18D bytes zeroed by the builder)
fields.evidence: Builder memsets +0x20..+0x1AC to zero (length 0x18D) before setting the rest; none of the exported methods touch it.

fields.name: battle_object_id
fields.evidence: Init slot copies the u32 at (boma->owner +0x8) (the battle object id) here.

fields.name: init_arg_kind
fields.evidence: Init slot copies its argument's +0x98 byte here.

fields.name: init_arg_line_set
fields.evidence: Init slot copies its argument's +0x9C (the same value MotionAnimcmdModule's init stores as its line id) here.

fields.name: init_arg_secondary
fields.evidence: Init slot copies its argument's +0xA8 here.

fields.name: boma_copy
fields.evidence: Init slot stores [this+0x8] here (pair store with +0x1C0).

fields.name: init_arg_object
fields.evidence: Init slot stores its argument's first word here.

fields.name: reserved_zero
fields.evidence: Zeroed by the builder and by the init slot.

fields.name: lua_agent (script agent bound to lua_thread)
fields.evidence: Uninit slot (+0x30) loads, zeroes and releases it through its own vtable +0x8; slots +0x38 and +0x48 pass it to f_710372e100 (run a lua function on the agent); destructor releases it.

fields.name: is_initialized (agent running)
fields.evidence: Slot +0x50 (f_710048aea0) returns ld8 +0x1E0; cleared by the uninit slot; builder 0.

fields.name: flag_1e1
fields.evidence: Slot +0x70 stores a bool here, slot +0x78 returns it; cleared by slot +0x38 (status change reset).

fields.name: execute_line (LuaScriptLineID currently executing)
fields.evidence: get_execute_line (slot +0x80, f_710048af00) returns ld32 +0x1E4; slot +0x38 sets it while it runs a line and resets it to 0. Values: LUA_SCRIPT_LINE_SYSTEM=0, SYSTEM_POST=1, STATUS=2, STATUS_SYSTEM=3, STATUS_END=4, STATUS_SHIFT=5, FIX_CAMERA=6, MAP_CORRECTION=7, FIX_POS_SLOW=8, WAZA_CUSTOMIZE=9 (MAX=10).

fields.name: line_enabled[LuaScriptLineID]
fields.evidence: is_valid_line (slot +0x68, f_710048aed0) returns ld8 this+0x1E8+line; enable_line (+0x58) stores 1, disable_line (+0x60) stores 0. Index: LUA_SCRIPT_LINE_SYSTEM=0, SYSTEM_POST=1, STATUS=2, STATUS_SYSTEM=3, STATUS_END=4, STATUS_SHIFT=5, FIX_CAMERA=6, MAP_CORRECTION=7, FIX_POS_SLOW=8, WAZA_CUSTOMIZE=9 (MAX=10).

fields.name: status_func_enabled[LuaScriptStatusFuncID]
fields.evidence: is_valid_func (slot +0xB8, f_710048b770) returns ld8 this+0x1F2+func; enable_func (+0xA8) stores 1, disable_func (+0xB0) stores 0; slot +0x38 zeroes +0x1E8..+0x207 (both flag arrays) at a status change. Index: LUA_SCRIPT_STATUS_FUNC_STATUS_PRE=0, STATUS_MAIN=1, STATUS_END=2, INIT_STATUS=3, EXEC_STATUS=4, EXEC_STOP=5, EXEC_STATUS_POST=6, EXIT_STATUS=7, MAP_CORRECTION=8, FIX_CAMERA=9, FIX_POS_SLOW=10, CHECK_DAMAGE=11, CHECK_ATTACK=12, ON_CHANGE_LR=13, LEAVE_STOP=14, NOTIFY_EVENT_GIMMICK=15, CALC_PARAM=16, RESERVE1..5=17..21 (MAX=22).

fields.name: status_data (vector of 176-byte entries = 22 lua function references, one entry per status kind)
fields.evidence: reserve_status_data_array (slot +0x88, f_710048af10) grows begin +0x208 / end +0x210 / capacity +0x218 to n zeroed 0xB0-byte entries (element count by /0xB0 arithmetic); builder reserves 256 entries (0xB000 bytes). 0xB0 = 22 x 8, one slot per LuaScriptStatusFuncID; slot +0xA0 (f_710048b6f0) returns entry[status][func] and slots +0x90/+0x98 fill entries.

fields.name: fighter_extra_block
fields.evidence: Fighter class only (0x228 vs 0x220 bytes): builder zeroes it (after passing +0x220 and a string to an init helper); the fighter destructor f_71006dc880 frees it.

pointers.to: lua_State (thread) of the object's script agent
status data array: entries of 22 x 8-byte lua function refs, indexed [status_kind][LuaScriptStatusFuncID]

notes: Simulation state: execute_line, the line/func enable flags (they gate which status lua functions run each frame), the status data table and the lua state/agent (scripts mutate WorkModule etc.). Fighter-class vtable: +0x28 init, +0x30 uninit, +0x38 run status-change reset, +0x48 run, +0x50 is_initialized, +0x58/+0x60/+0x68 enable/disable/is_valid_line, +0x70/+0x78 set/get +0x1E1, +0x80 get_execute_line, +0x88 reserve_status_data_array, +0x90/+0x98 set status data, +0xA0 get status data, +0xA8/+0xB0/+0xB8 enable/disable/is_valid_func; +0x110..+0x128 are fighter overrides (agent call helpers). The 0x18D-byte zeroed region at +0x20 was not read by any exported method; its content is unknown.
